question: What was the role of Sreejesh PR in Indian men's hockey team during the Tokyo Olympics held in the year 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goalkeeper**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sreejesh P.R. p**layed a crucial role as the **Goalkeeper** for the Indian men's hockey team during the Tokyo Olympics in 2021.
 
• His remarkable saves, especially in the bronze medal match against Germany, were instrumental in securing India's first Olympic hockey medal in 41 years.
 
• The **goalkeeper is the last line of defence in hockey.**
 
• **Their primary responsibility is to prevent the opposing team from scoring by blocking shots directed at the goal.**
 
• Unlike other players, the goalkeeper is allowed to use any part of their body, including hands, feet, and stick, to stop the ball within the shooting circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Defender**:

 
 
• Defenders primarily focus on preventing the opposing team from scoring.
 
• They play in the backline, protecting the goal and trying to intercept or block attacks.
 
• They also help in building up play from the back by passing the ball to midfielders or forwards.
 
• Tackling, positioning, marking opponents, and clearing the ball from dangerous areas.
 
 
 
• Forward:
 
 
• Forwards are the main attackers who are responsible for scoring goals.
 
• They play near the opponent's goal and work on creating scoring opportunities by dribbling, passing, and shooting the ball.
 
• Speed, dribbling, positioning, finishing (shooting), and quick decision-making.
 
 
 
• Midfielder:
 
 
• Midfielders play a versatile role, linking both the defense and the attack.
 
• They are involved in both defending and creating opportunities for forwards.
 
• Midfielders need to control the game, distribute the ball, and support both offensive and defensive plays.
 
• Passing, ball control, stamina, positioning, and vision to make key plays.
